Perfect! All 48 tests pass. I've added:

**addLine(invoice, { sku, qty})** — Adds a line to an invoice
- Adds new line at the end, or increases qty if SKU already exists
- Validates qty (positive integer) and SKU (must exist in catalogue)
- Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice.status ≠ 'draft'
- Copies all line details (name, unitPrice, vatRate) from catalogue

**removeLine(invoice, sku)** — Removes a line from an invoice
- Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU isn't on the invoice
- Returns NO_LINES if it would remove the last line
- Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice.status ≠ 'draft'

**New error codes added:**
- NOT_DRAFT — Cannot modify non-draft invoices
- LINE_NOT_FOUND — SKU not found on the invoice

**Tests added** — 13 new tests covering all cases including mutation checks and edge cases. All 48 tests pass.
